# Erdos.p89 — Erdős problem 89

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/89
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/89.lean`, theorem `erdos_89`, AMS 52).

Erdős [Er46] asked whether every set of $n$ distinct points in $\mathbb{R}^2$
determines $\gg \frac{n}{\sqrt{\log n}}$ many distinct distances.

## Statement
(fun (n : ℕ) => n/(n : ℝ).log.sqrt) =O[atTop] (fun n => (minimalDistinctDistances n : ℝ))

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
